name: 01-before-property
title: Load the property to start
explanation: Enter the address, then select LOAD PROPERTY & TRACE ROOF.

name: 02-drawing
title: Trace this roof section
explanation: Trace the roof corners and select this section’s actual pitch beside Save. The default 5/12 is not confirmed.

name: 03-saved-unconfirmed
title: Roof confirmation required
explanation: Review each saved area and pitch above. Include every roof you are pricing, then confirm pitches and included roofs.

name: 04-price-next
title: Enter this job’s price
explanation: Enter this job’s rate. Use 0 only for an intentionally free service.

name: 05-customer-next
title: Add customer details
explanation: Enter the customer name in Step 4.

name: 06-editing
title: Select this section’s pitch
explanation: Trace the roof corners and select this section’s actual pitch beside Save. The default 5/12 is not confirmed.

name: 07-cancelled
title: Roof confirmation required
explanation: Review each saved area and pitch above. Include every roof you are pricing, then confirm pitches and included roofs.

name: 08-two-sections
title: Roof confirmation required
explanation: Review each saved area and pitch above. Include every roof you are pricing, then confirm pitches and included roofs.

name: 09-create-next
title: Create the customer estimate
explanation: Review pricing and customer details, then create the estimate.

name: 10-reopened
title: Roof confirmation required
explanation: Review each saved area and pitch above. Include every roof you are pricing, then confirm pitches and included roofs.
